commits.author: StanGirard
commits.subject: Refactor session status handling: Simplify status types and introduce attention reasons
commits.body:
- Updated session status types to 'working', 'needs_attention', and 'idle'.
- Introduced attention reasons: 'permission', 'input', 'plan_approval', and 'task_complete'.
- Refactored components to use new status and attention reason logic.
- Adjusted filtering and sorting in various components to align with new status definitions.
- Updated notification logic to trigger only for 'needs_attention' status.
- Modified hooks and scripts to reflect changes in status handling.
- Enhanced type definitions and added tests for new status and attention reason types.
